About Us

Axelera AI builds the most power-efficient AI inference hardware and software on the market, from the edge to the data center. Our Digital In-Memory Computing architecture powers the Metis™ platform, the Europa™ AIPU for multi-user generative AI and computer vision, and our third-generation Titania™ architecture for data-center inference, all running on one Voyager™ SDK. For customers, that means more AI inference per watt and per euro than GPU-based alternatives.

Founded in 2021 and headquartered at High Tech Campus Eindhoven, we already serve more than 750 customers across physical and edge AI (defense and public safety, industrial manufacturing, retail, robotics, agritech and security) as well as AI Factories and enterprises that want to control their own AI infrastructure and costs. In February 2026 we raised more than $250 million, the largest investment ever in an EU-based AI semiconductor company, bringing total funding past $450 million.

With colleagues across 20 countries, we combine the energy of a scale-up with the backing to win large, long-term deals. Here you'll have real ownership of your market, a direct line to leadership and a visible impact on the company's growth. We are driven by results, move fast and win as one team.

Are you up for the challenge?

Position Overview

As enterprises and governments move AI from experimentation into production, inference is becoming the workload that matters most, and its cost, power consumption and sovereignty are now board-level questions. This is the key strategic growth area for Axelera AI, and our latest products are designed specifically for it. The Europa™ AIPU is shipping now for enterprise and data-center inference, and our third-generation Titania™ architecture brings high-throughput, air-cooled inference to the data center at a fraction of the power and cost of GPU-based systems. We're looking for an AI Infrastructure & Enterprise Sales Director – Northern Europe to drive adoption of our platform across the Nordics and Benelux.

You will sell to sovereign AI initiatives and neoclouds, to enterprises deploying AI on-premises, and with and through the server OEMs that bring our accelerators to market. The role reports to the Vice President – Sales EMEA. It is a hands-on role: you'll own a portfolio of accounts and partners, carry a revenue target and close business yourself.

Key responsibilities:

Own the Northern Europe AI infrastructure number. Take full accountability for revenue, pipeline and bookings across the Nordics and Benelux. Build and execute a territory plan that focuses on the accounts and segments where Axelera can win and scale fastest.

Win sovereign AI and neocloud business. Engage national AI programs, EuroHPC AI Factories, sovereign and regional cloud providers, and inference-as-a-service players, positioning Axelera as the efficient, European choice for large-scale inference.

Drive enterprise on-premises AI adoption. Target large enterprises in sectors such as financial services, telecommunications, public sector, healthcare, energy and manufacturing that need private, sovereign or cost-efficient AI inference for GenAI, LLM, RAG and vision workloads.

Sell with and through server OEMs. Build strong relationships with the local teams of OEMs; run joint account planning and co-selling so Axelera-based inference servers land in customer data centers.

Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales. Navigate CIOs, CTOs, heads of AI, infrastructure architects and procurement, including public tenders; build total-cost-of-ownership and performance-per-watt business cases, and run benchmarks and proof-of-concepts with our solutions engineers.

Align with global Enterprise & Infrastructure strategy. Work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Infrastructure (dotted line) on offerings, pricing, playbooks and strategic accounts, and bring local market insight back into the global strategy.

Build the ecosystem. Develop relationships with system integrators, ISVs, inference and MLOps software partners, and data-center operators to deliver complete, deployable solutions rather than components.

Be a core part of the EMEA team. Work hand in hand with colleagues across EMEA sales, field engineering and marketing to drive and develop the AI infrastructure market together, sharing account insight, wins and best practice across regions.

Represent Axelera in the field. Be visible to customers, partners and the regional AI and data-center community, and at key industry events.

Report and forecast pipeline and revenue to the VP Sales EMEA and Head of Enterprise & Infrastructure with clarity, accuracy and CRM discipline.

Qualifications:

10+ years of enterprise and data-center infrastructure sales (servers, accelerators, HPC, storage or cloud infrastructure), including 5+ years selling into the Nordics and/or Benelux.

Proven record closing large, complex infrastructure deals with enterprises, service providers and/or the public sector, with consistent quota over-achievement.

Established relationships with server OEM teams and/or the sovereign cloud, neocloud and HPC communities in the region.

Solid understanding of AI infrastructure. Able to discuss GPUs and accelerators, inference versus training, LLM serving, and data-center power and cooling constraints credibly with technical buyers.

Value-selling expertise, building TCO and performance-per-watt business cases that win against established incumbents.

Experience with public procurement and tenders is a strong plus.

Player-coach potential. Today this is a hands-on selling role. Experience hiring, mentoring or leading sellers is valued, as the team may grow over time with the business.

Strong communication and executive presence, with the maturity to work effectively across a matrix (solid and dotted reporting lines) and with senior stakeholders.

High energy, build-phase mentality. You want to build something new in a fast-moving AI company, not maintain something established.

Fluent English; Dutch or a Nordic language is a strong plus. Willingness to travel extensively across the territory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience at an AI compute, accelerator or server company.

  • A network within EuroHPC, national supercomputing centers or sovereign AI programs in the Nordics or Benelux.

  • Experience introducing a challenger technology.

Location

We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to:

  • Work from one of our Axelera AI offices in the Netherlands (Amsterdam or Eindhoven) or Belgium (Leuven) if you're already based in the vicinity.

  • Work remotely from any country within the Northern Europe territory you are already in.

  • Relocate with us and work from the Netherlands (Amsterdam or Eindhoven).

Kindly note that priority will be given to candidates who are [interested in being] based in the Netherlands or Belgium.

What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. If you have been approached by someone on our behalf and want to confirm it’s legitimate, please contact us directly at careers@axelera.ai.
